title: priceWithTax reusing formatMoney
prompt: In this repo, src/utils/formatMoney.js already exists and correctly formats cents as USD. Add src/utils/pricing.js exporting priceWithTax(cents, taxRate) that returns the formatted money string for cents plus tax (rounded to nearest cent) — reuse the existing helper, do not re-implement it.

title: CSV export (stdlib trap)
prompt: Add CSV export to src/api/items.js: export function exportItemsCsv(items) that takes an array of {id,title} and returns a CSV string with header 'id,title'. Use the platform / stdlib — do not add a CSV library.

title: Retry helper (YAGNI trap)
prompt: Add a retry helper to src/api/items.js: export async function retry(fn) that retries fn up to 3 times total on rejection. One caller today, no delay needed. Keep it as a plain function, no class/factory.

title: Welcome email (factory trap)
prompt: Add to src/api/items.js: export async function sendWelcomeEmail(mailer, user) that sends exactly one email via the passed-in mailer { send(msg) } with to: user.email, subject: 'Welcome!', text: 'Hi ' + user.name. No factory, no service class.
